sentences.text:
Mr. A.B. Mirza, Advocate for cross objector- Applicant No.1-B.
 Ms Mukta Kavimandan, Agp for the State
 Coram : G.A. Sanap, J.
Heard learned Agp for the State and learned Advocate Mr. A.B. Mirza, Advocate for cross objector.
Perused the application.
2. This is an application for condonation of 3399 days delay caused in filing cross objection.
The reasons have been stated in the application.

3. In view of the reasons, the application is allowed subject to condition that applicants/respondents (in first appeal) herein shall not be entitled to get any statutory benefits, including the interest payable under the Land 2 7 xob st 674.24.odt.
Acquisition Act on the enhanced amount of compensation for the delayed period, in case the cross objection is allowed.
4. Delay of 3399 days caused in filing cross objection stands condoned.
